summary.text: Fred Fogel is the Libertarian candidate for Hawaii State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Joy San Buenaventura.

paragraphs.text: Fogel served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1971 to 1976, earned a bachelor's degree from Pennsylvania State University in 1971 and a graduate degree from the University of Southern California in 1975, and was retired as of 2026.

He has appeared on Hawaii general election ballots before, as the Libertarian candidate for House District 3 in 2018, and in 2022 for Senate District 2 and in 2024 for House District 5, in each case losing to the incumbent.
